subject: Your ears just went flat
preview_text: One tap. 30 seconds. You'll never unhear it.
body_paragraphs: You just downloaded Bass Booster. Probably because your favorite track sounded like it was playing through a tin can. I get it. I built this for that exact moment.
Here's the thing: your phone can hit harder than you think. Most people never tweak a single setting. They just live with flat, lifeless audio. But you're not most people.

Open the app. Drag the Boost slider to the right. Just once. That's it. In 30 seconds, you'll hear what a real drop feels like through your earbuds. The bass virtualizer kicks in system-wide. Spotify, YouTube, TikTok, games. All of it.
Try it now. Feel the difference. P.S. That slider goes way past your system max. Premium unlocks the full 200% boost and the 10-band EQ. But start with one tap.
